description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

description:
About the job

Responsibilities

About the Team

The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the commerce channel of choice for merchants, creators, and affiliates.

You've seen the virality and impact of #TikTokMadeMeBuyIt. Come join the team that is helping scale that phenomenon, and pioneer Content & Creator commerce in the LATAM. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the leading, on-trend commerce platform of choice for brands, creators, and shoppers. We are an entrepreneurial team, passionate about shaping the future of shopping.

The TikTok Shop LATAM operation team aims to deliver high quality products together with a unique customer experience via TikTok. The team is responsible for building the TikTok e-Commerce partnership for the TikTok e-commerce business in the US. With more than 1 billion loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join us to build an e-Commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users together.

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

Successful candidates must be able to commit to at least 6 months long internship period.

Responsibilities:

Seller Growth & Engagement


 Support the execution of seller growth programs such as webinars, educational sessions, and platform campaigns while assisting Category and Operations teams in promoting key initiatives including campaigns, LIVE activities, and promotional events.
 Help drive seller participation in platform programs, campaigns, and content initiatives and monitor seller feedback to help identify opportunities to improve engagement.


Content & Communication


 Support the creation and coordination of seller-facing communications across email, social channels, webinars, and community groups to help ensure communications are clear, accurate, and aligned with platform guidelines.
 Coordinate with internal teams to gather information and assets for seller communications, and assist in maintaining communication calendars and campaign materials organized and updated


Campaign & Project Management


 Support cross-functional seller marketing projects by coordinating with teams such as Content, LIVE, Product, Legal, and Operations.
 Track timelines, deliverables, and follow-ups to help ensure smooth execution and assist with campaign setup, reporting, and operational tasks.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


 Applicants are kindly requested to submit an English-language resume
 Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or Communications
 Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
 Strong communication and collaboration skills.
 Strong interest in e-commerce, creator economy, digital marketing, and marketplace platforms.
 Analytical mindset with basic knowledge of data analysis and reporting.


Preferred Qualification


 Previous internship or extracurricular experience in marketing, e-commerce, digital content, operations, or project coordination is a plus.


By submitting an application for this role, you accept and agree to our global applicant privacy policy, which may be accessed here: https://careers.tiktok.com/legal/privacy

Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

About the job

Senior SEO Specialist (Remote) — LionHead Digital

Type: Full-Time | Remote

Base Salary: $30,600 – $40,000 USD/year (DOE)




Before You Apply

We review every application closely. If you don’t meet all four of the following, please don’t apply:




2-5+ years of hands-on SEO execution at a marketing agency.
Experience managing local SEO, technical SEO, and content strategy simultaneously across multiple client accounts.
Proven, documented results. You can show before/after ranking and organic lead data from accounts you've owned.




Who We Are

LionHead Digital is a boutique agency exclusively serving criminal defense, personal injury, and family law firms across the U.S.

We don’t do vanity metrics — we deliver verified lead reporting, measurable results, and the kind of transparency that keeps clients for years. Nine years in, we’re building the most advanced law firm marketing system in the country.




The Role

The Senior SEO Specialist is responsible for leading the execution and optimization of SEO strategies that drive measurable improvements in search visibility, rankings, and organic lead volume across assigned client portfolios.




This role goes beyond execution, requiring strategic thinking, performance ownership, and continuous optimization. The Senior SEO Specialist ensures high-quality delivery, refines and evolves SOPs, and proactively identifies opportunities to enhance impact and efficiency.

They collaborate cross-functionally with SEO leadership, Content, Development, and Project Management teams, while also serving as a subject matter expert and mentor, guiding best practices and elevating overall team performance.




You're the One If

You treat every client account like it's your own business. You know rankings mean nothing if they don't produce verified, qualified leads, and you connect every deliverable back to that outcome. You track what actually matters: organic lead volume, cost per lead from search, and rankings for high-intent keywords. You've built SOPs, trained junior specialists, and can spot an A-player within two weeks. You level up constantly, bring new ideas without being asked, and when something's underperforming, you say so clearly. No hiding, no spin.




What You'll Do

SEO Strategy and Execution

Own full SEO lifecycle across all assigned accounts: audit, strategy, implementation, optimization, and reporting
Manage on-page, off-page, technical SEO, and Google Business Profile optimization simultaneously
Review client goals, market competition, and keyword landscape before every engagement. No guessing.
Validate tracking accuracy across Google Search Console, GA4, call tracking, and CRM attribution before campaigns go live

Performance and Optimization

Own keyword rankings, organic traffic growth, and verified qualified lead volume across all managed accounts
Run ongoing tests on content strategy, internal linking, page structure, and local SEO signals
Monitor and refine keyword targeting, content gaps, and backlink profiles continuously
Flag underperformance early with a documented action plan. No surprises, no excuses.

Process and Leadership

Build and document SEO SOPs, QA checklists, and campaign frameworks from day one
Train and mentor SEO specialists as the team scales under you
Set clear KPIs for team members and evaluate performance honestly and consistently
Oversee and guide existing team members on performance standards and deliverable quality

Cross-Team Coordination

Partner with Client Success on lead quality feedback and client communication
Coordinate with Web/Dev on technical fixes, page speed, schema, and site structure improvements
Collaborate with Content on topical authority strategy, content briefs, and publication cadence
Communicate clearly with Operations and leadership on performance, risks, and opportunities

Internal Campaigns

Manage LionHead's own organic presence and SEO strategy held to the same standard as client work




How We Measure Success

Keyword ranking improvements for high-intent, case-driving terms.
Verified lead volume from organic,local & Ai search per account per month.
Organic traffic growth month-over-month across managed accounts.
Tracking accuracy. Zero broken attribution is the standard.
Documented SEO wins tied directly to client-reported case volume.




Who You Are

Required experience:

2–5+ years of SEO management at a marketing agency.
Demonstrated results. Before/after ranking and organic lead data from accounts you've directly owned.
Experience with legal, local, or high-intent service industries strongly preferred.
Deep command of on-page SEO, technical SEO, local SEO, link building, Google Business Profile, GSC, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, and schema markup.
Experience building and documenting SEO SOPs and training materials.
Fluent English, written and spoken.




Skills and Traits

Operates independently. You identify problems and solve them without being asked.
Data-driven decision maker who tracks qualified leads, not just traffic.
Connects every ranking and visibility metric back to case outcomes for the client.
Operations-minded. You default to documentation, process, and scalable systems.
Follows industry experts, tests new strategies, and proactively brings ideas.
Direct communicator. You say what needs to be said, when it needs to be said.




How We Work

Our core values aren't posters on a wall — they guide every decision we make.

Never Settle — We chase mastery, not perfection. Always hungry, always improving.
We Give a Damn — We show up, care deeply, and own outcomes for clients and teammates.
Courageous Communication — Truth early, respect always. We don't hide problems or avoid tough conversations.
Obsessed with Outcomes — Client results are our only scoreboard. When they grow, we grow.







Compensation & Benefits

Base Salary: $30,600 – $40,000 USD/year (based on experience and results).
Performance-based bonuses tied to retention and agency growth.
Paid time off.
Paid training and professional development assistance.
100% remote — work from home.
Direct reporting line to the CEO and a seat at the leadership table.







👉 Apply today to join a results-driven agency where your leadership directly impacts our clients and our future.

description:
About the job

Head de Promoción — Vertical Salud / Equipo Médico | Leasing y Crédito para Médicos

 

Sobre la empresa

Nuestro cliente es una SOFOM con 17 años de operación en el sector financiero mexicano, especializada en soluciones de crédito y arrendamiento (puro y financiero) para segmentos profesionales y empresariales. Cuenta con un equipo consolidado de más de 45 colaboradores, una cultura organizacional basada en integridad, cumplimiento y alto desempeño, y proyecta certificarse como Great Place to Work en 2027. Su estándar operativo es elevado, formal y orientado a resultados, con sólida disciplina regulatoria heredada de 7 años bajo supervisión CNBV.

 

Resumen de la oportunidad

Buscamos a un profesional comercial senior para construir y liderar la Vertical de Salud de una SOFOM con 17 años de operación (antes regulada CNBV). El objetivo: colocar crédito y arrendamiento (puro y financiero) a médicos especialistas, clínicas y distribuidores de equipo médico, a través de Vendor Programs con manufactureros y comercializadores.




No es un puesto heredado ni un arranque en frío: la empresa ya opera líneas preaprobadas para médicos —hasta $2.5 MDP en equipo médico y $1.5 MDP en autos— con documentación mínima. Tu foco es colocar, no pelear aprobaciones.

 

Este rol es para ti solo si cumples con los requisitos indispensables. Lee con atención antes de postular.

 

Responsabilidades principales

Prospectar, identificar y desarrollar Vendor Programs con manufactureros y comercializadores de equipo médico.
Prospectar directamente a médicos especialistas para AP-Leasing.
Diseñar y ejecutar programas vendor que aseguren colocación, trabajando en dos escalas: manufactureros y distribuidores, incluyendo planes de incentivos para distribuidores.
Ejecutar venta consultiva y venta de valor: identificación de stakeholders, calificación, manejo de tickets desde $500K hasta $3 MDP (foco principal: ultrasonidos $800K–$1.5 MDP).
Negociar y cerrar operaciones rentables dentro de los parámetros financieros establecidos (tasas, comisiones e incentivos).
Brindar servicio postventa para sostener una relación contractual promedio de ~39 meses.
Coordinar cotización, integración y armado de expedientes con apoyo de Mid/Back Office.
Coordinar análisis de crédito y aclaración de dudas con áreas internas.
Realizar primer contacto de cobranza en caso de retraso (modelo principal: débito directo).
Visitar Vendors y clientes para mantenimiento de relación.
Elaborar reportes de promoción y pipeline semanal.
Participar en el reclutamiento progresivo de su equipo comercial.




Alcance del cargo

Cobertura inicial: Zona Metropolitana del Valle de México (CDMX + Estado de México).
Expansión gradual a Querétaro, Hidalgo, Puebla, Morelos y Tlaxcala.
Estructura proyectada: de 1 a 4 Ejecutivos de Promoción y Servicio/Relación a construir progresivamente (sin equipo inicial; estructura se forma a partir del mes 3).
Reporte directo a la Dirección General / CEO (a futuro, al Director Comercial).
Responsabilidad de P&L de la vertical.
Interlocución con vendors, distribuidores, médicos especialistas, clínicas, áreas internas de crédito, operaciones, jurídico y Mid/Back Office.




Perfil ideal

Profesional con sólido recorrido en ventas, promoción y servicio dentro del sector financiero (SOFOM, arrendadora o banca PYME) y/o en la vertical de equipo médico/healthcare. Combina mentalidad de hunter, disciplina de pipeline, capacidad de venta consultiva de alto ticket y autonomía para construir una unidad de negocio desde su fase fundacional. Persona tenaz, organizada, íntegra, con vocación de resultados y comodidad en ciclos comerciales largos y tickets elevados.




Requisitos indispensables

Mínimo 7 años de experiencia en ventas, promoción o servicio a clientes en sector financiero (SOFOM, arrendadora, banca PYME) y/o vertical de equipo médico.
Tickets históricos demostrables iguales o superiores a $2 MDP.
Uso disciplinado de CRM con al menos 3 años de experiencia (requisito irrenunciable).
Licencia de conducir vigente (se asigna vehículo).
Disponibilidad para presencia obligatoria los lunes en oficina de Toluca.
Aprobar evaluaciones de ingreso (Midot) y evaluación anual (Trusty).
Tolerancia a procesos de cumplimiento regulatorio (PLD, KYC, regulación residual SOFOM).
Documentación de nómina mexicana completa (RFC, CURP, NSS, identificación).
Aprobar buró de crédito y buró legal.




Experiencia requerida

Mínimo 7 años en ventas/promoción/servicio a clientes.
Preferentemente en sector financiero (SOFOM, arrendadora, banca PYME) y/o vertical de equipo médico.
Perfil ideal: combinación de ambos mundos (financiero + healthcare/equipo médico).
Experiencia comprobable cerrando Vendor Programs con manufactureros o comercializadores de equipo médico es altamente valorada.




Conocimientos técnicos

CRM (cualquiera) con uso disciplinado mínimo 3 años — requisito irrenunciable.
Análisis de crédito: lectura de estados financieros, flujo, garantías, buró de crédito y buró legal.
Productos financieros: leasing, arrendamiento puro, arrendamiento financiero, crédito simple, crédito revolvente, sale-leaseback.
Matemáticas financieras: TIR, tasas piso/techo, valor residual, renta inicial, amortización, IVA en operaciones.
Manejo de cotizadores y herramientas de pricing.
Office (Excel intermedio-avanzado, Word, PowerPoint).
Marco PLD/KYC.
Deseable: conocimiento del mercado de equipo médico (marcas, rangos de precio, distribuidores).
Español nativo. Inglés básico deseable para fichas técnicas (no excluyente).




Habilidades y competencias clave

Motor comercial: alta motivación, responsabilidad y hambre de vender.
ADN de ventas: consistencia, permanencia, manejo de rechazo, comodidad con tickets altos y ciclos largos, autonomía operativa.
Venta consultiva y de valor: identificación de stakeholders, calificación, cierre, manejo de presupuestos altos.
Organización y disciplina (metodologías tipo Eisenhower, 80/20, Franklin Covey).
Tenacidad, empowerment, comunicación efectiva.
Mindset abierto y flexible, empatía, energía y visión de negocio.
Integridad como valor no negociable.




Condiciones del cargo

Ubicación: Toluca, Estado de México (Av. Independencia, Zona Industrial). Sin restricción de zona de residencia.
Modalidad: Híbrida — lunes obligatorio en oficina de Toluca; resto de la semana en calle (CDMX/ZMVM). Pie de playa en CDMX (Coworking, en proceso).
Horario: Oficina de 9:00 a 18:00 (lunes a viernes). Rol comercial sin horario fijo: ajustado a agenda de Vendors y clientes.
Viajes: 1 a 2 viajes cortos al mes (inicial ZMVM; expansión a Querétaro, Hidalgo, Puebla, Morelos y Tlaxcala). Gastos cubiertos.
Disponibilidad adicional: citas fuera de horario (aeropuerto, sábados ocasionales), eventos de industria (expos médicas, congresos) y juntas extendidas con Vendors.
Tipo de contrato: directo por nómina, tiempo indeterminado, con prestaciones superiores a la ley.
Vehículo: auto asignado por la empresa, todo pagado.




Beneficios

Sueldo fijo mensual bruto competitivo, integrado por sueldo base más bonos de asistencia y puntualidad.
Prestaciones mensuales: vales de despensa, fondo de ahorro (13% topado por ley) y apoyo de gasolina.
Prestaciones anuales: aguinaldo de 15 días, vacaciones de 12 días desde el primer año, prima vacacional del 25%, seguro de gastos médicos mayores para titular (con opción para familia) y seguro de vida.
Beneficio especial: auto asignado de la empresa, todo pagado.
Esquema de comisiones escalable sobre colocación neta, con bonos trimestrales (boosters) y bono anual.
Prestaciones superiores a la ley.
Crecimiento profesional con proyección de liderar y construir un equipo propio.
Exposición directa a Dirección General y participación en una vertical estratégica desde su fase fundacional.




Razones para postularse

Construir una vertical de negocio desde cero, con autonomía operativa dentro de parámetros claros (tasas, comisiones e incentivos).
Base de doctores preaprobados disponible desde el día uno: hasta $2.5 MDP en equipo médico y $1.5 MDP en autos.
Portafolio financiero robusto y diferenciado: leasing, arrendamiento puro y financiero, crédito simple y crédito revolvente con garantía.
Propuesta comercial y cotizadores listos (vendor armado en 24 horas).
Esquema de compensación variable atractivo y escalable, con boosters trimestrales y bono anual.
Prestaciones superiores a la ley y nivel de mora del segmento por debajo del 1%.
Posibilidad real de construir una estructura propia de hasta 4 ejecutivos.
Reporte directo a CEO con liderazgo situacional, formal, exigente y orientado a resultados, que privilegia tenacidad y organización.




Si cuentas con experiencia en promoción y venta consultiva de productos financieros de alto ticket (leasing, arrendamiento, crédito) en sector SOFOM, arrendadora, banca PYME y/o vertical de equipo médico, con manejo disciplinado de CRM, desarrollo de Vendor Programs y cierre de operaciones desde $500K hasta $3 MDP, y te interesa integrarte a una posición de liderazgo comercial estratégica, de nueva creación, con autonomía operativa, modalidad híbrida (lunes presencial obligatorio en Toluca), auto asignado, esquema de comisiones escalable y proyección de construir un equipo propio, postúlate por este medio.

 

Proceso de selección

Filtraje Curricular por ZEUS RH.
Llenado de Cuestionario inicial.
7 Evaluaciones de Competencias humanas y Técnicas en plataforma www.zeusrh.com (DISC, Eneagrama HIT, Terman-Merrill, Integridad y Confianza, IPV, AI@Work y Closer).
Videopresentación (máximo 3:00 min) respondiendo preguntas que se enviarán.
Entrevista presencial en cliente.

 

Cómo postular

Si cuentas con la experiencia y visión para desempeñarte exitosamente en esta posición, postúlate directamente a través de LinkedIn o, preferiblemente, escríbenos a nuestro número de WhatsApp 5531119590 con el mensaje: "Me postulo al cargo de: Head de Promoción — Vertical Salud / Equipo Médico". Como segunda opción, también puedes enviar tu CV actualizado a: reclutamiento@zeusrh.com colocando en el asunto: "Me postulo al cargo de: Head de Promoción — Vertical Salud / Equipo Médico".

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

In this role, you will lead marketing growth and product strategy, connecting business ambition with brand vision through data-driven and strategic thinking. You will define clear goals and plans that drive market share growth and user value.

You will develop and scale innovative marketing initiatives, translating insights into strong brand strategies, campaigns, and messaging frameworks. With a business-driven mindset, you will use internal and external data to identify growth opportunities across product, value proposition, and market expansion.

You will turn high-level strategy into concrete execution—campaign blueprints, briefs, media inputs, and RTBs—while tracking performance across brand and business metrics to optimize impact. You will also create toolkits and playbooks to scale learnings, ensure brand consistency, and stay ahead of market and consumer trends.

In this role, you'll be...


Leading marketing growth and product strategy connecting the business ambition with the brand vision based on analytical and strategic thinking, including development of goals, approach, strategic definition and plan. 
Bring innovative marketing ideas to the table, and best in class strategic initiatives, obtaining buy-in and efficiently implementing them at scale through marketing programs. 
Business driven mindset defining strategic plans and actions to increase market share. 
Use internal and external data to find relevant insights that transform into effective Brand insights, campaigns and content. 
Drive research recommendations, and discussions to find sources of growth around the product, user value proposition and market expansion. 
Translate high-level strategy and positioning into concrete deliverables (campaign blueprints, messaging frameworks, value propositions, etc.)
Develop marketing campaigns; providing input into media plans, key messaging RTBs and strategic briefs.
Develop campaign reporting crossing business results with brand results to find sources of growth for user value creation based on learnings and optimizations. 
Develop enablement materials (Toolkits, playbooks) to scale new developments/learnings and help drive brand consistency and market penetration.
Remain fully informed on market trends and marketing brand campaigns.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


6+ years of relevant experience developing marketing strategy and plan at a regional level. 
Strong stakeholder management and leadership influencing teams. 
Knowledge in product marketing, inapp campaigns and go to marketing strategies. 
Fast learner; ability to manage competing priorities and operate effectively in a matrixed organization / fast-paced environment
Understands the “why” and applies critical thinking and strategic reasoning to decision making. 
Experience in Brand and business KPIs analysis 
Experience with in-app and 360 campaigns
Be able to work under constant deadline pressure and manage multiple projects.
You are fluent in English. 



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

skills: Serve as the primary lead for customer migration engagements, responsible for the technical delivery, project health, and successful go-live outcomes.

Platform Mastery: Advanced knowledge of Salesforce core (Sales/Service) or specialized clouds (Marketing/Data/Revenue/Tableau).
AI Engagement: Familiarity with using AI agents or automation tools to handle data mapping, sentiment analysis, or task automation.
Integration Knowledge: Understanding of how the target cloud integrates with telephony, third-party data sources, and self-service portals.
Certifications in relevant domains (e.g., Marketing Cloud Consultant, CPQ Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, or Tableau Desktop Specialist).
Prior experience as an Individual Contributor leading multi-million dollar transformation projects.
Advanced AI Associate or "Agentblazer" certifications.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Migration Delivery Lead is a high-impact individual contributor responsible for leading complex, high-stakes customer migration engagements from inception to successful validation. Operating at the tip of the spear, you function as the primary technical and strategic orchestrator for a specific migration pod, ensuring that customers achieve rapid time-to-value while migrating to modern cloud architectures. This role is built on a deep, seamless partnership with the Global Delivery Center (GDC), and Outbound Product Management as an aligned unit to ensure flawless, around-the-clock execution of migration engagements.

This role is designed for a versatile expert who thrives at the absolute intersection of customer relationship management and rigorous technical execution. You will act as a trusted advisor, bridging the gap between the customer’s legacy environment and their future-state platform by aggressively driving the adoption of automated playbooks and cutting-edge AI tools to dramatically compress delivery timelines. Beyond execution, you serve as a critical voice of the customer within the migration team feedback loop, systematically capturing real-world field insights, user friction, and system limitations to advocate directly to Product and Engineering for tool optimization. By orchestrating a unified front between the client, the account team, and your GDC engineering partners, you ensure that every engagement eliminates bespoke manual effort in favor of scalable, automated transformation.

Responsibilities

Customer Engagement and Value Alignment


Serve as the primary lead for customer migration engagements, responsible for the technical delivery, project health, and successful go-live outcomes.
Partner closely with Account Teams and Sales leadership to align migration technical goals with the broader customer business strategy and renewal/expansion targets.
Successfully manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, translating complex migration roadblocks into actionable business decisions.
Develop and execute basic plans to focus time on high-impact milestones, taking full responsibility for pod-level project tasks and timelines.
Conduct enablement and alignment sessions with customer stakeholders to ensure their workforce is prepared for the platform transition.


Strategic Partnership and Tooling Adoption


AI-Driven Delivery: Drive the adoption and usage of toolkits, using AI agents and automation to accelerate discovery, mapping, and code conversion.
GDC Collaboration: Partner deeply with the Global Delivery Center (GDC) team, offloading repeatable technical tasks while maintaining overall accountability for the quality of the output.
Outbound Product Liaison: Work in lockstep with Outbound Product Managers to stay ahead of product roadmaps and provide field feedback that influences future migration patterns.
Identify underutilized platform features and align the migration roadmap to increase customer throughput and adoption of modern platform capabilities.


Technical Health and Subject Matter Expertise


Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the primary SME in at least one key domain: Marketing Cloud, Data 360, Revenue Cloud, or Tableau, providing deep-dive technical guidance during the migration.
AI Literacy: Proficiency in using natural-language commands and prompt engineering to guide AI agents in retrieving data and generating migration health reports.
Incident Interface: Serve as the technical point of contact for major migration incidents, coordinating with Engineering and Product to protect the customer’s revenue during "cutover" phases.
Proactively monitor technical trends and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure the migrated environment is optimized for performance and stability.


Required Qualifications


Experience: 8+ years of experience in Professional Services, Customer Success, or Technical Consulting, with a specific focus on large-scale migrations.
Domain Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience in one or more of the following: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Data 360 (Data Cloud), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.
Consulting Skills: Demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate technical discussions, and handle objections at the stakeholder level.
Technical Fluency: Ability to translate complex technical architectures into business terms and guide customers through complex data transformations.
Collaboration: Proven track record of working successfully with global/offshore delivery models (GDC) to accelerate project timelines.


Cloud/Platform & Technical Requirements


Platform Mastery: Advanced knowledge of Salesforce core (Sales/Service) or specialized clouds (Marketing/Data/Revenue/Tableau).
AI Engagement: Familiarity with using AI agents or automation tools to handle data mapping, sentiment analysis, or task automation.
Integration Knowledge: Understanding of how the target cloud integrates with telephony, third-party data sources, and self-service portals.


Preferred Qualifications


Certifications in relevant domains (e.g., Marketing Cloud Consultant, CPQ Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, or Tableau Desktop Specialist).
Prior experience as an Individual Contributor leading multi-million dollar transformation projects.
Advanced AI Associate or "Agentblazer" certifications.


Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Objectives

Design websites, execute campaigns, and propose ideas for Saya Biologics' image and digital presence, ensuring visual and editorial consistency across external channels.

Create and manage content for social media (primarily LinkedIn) and other digital channels that reinforce Saya's positioning as an agile, digitally native biopharmaceutical company focused on accessibility.

Use of tools such as Claude Design, WhatsApp for Business, Notion, Gemini, or other similar platforms.

Operate an editorial calendar with a marketing focus (audiences, messaging, formats, timing, owners, and approvals) to communicate launches, partnerships, and corporate milestones.

Coordinate with Marketing, Business Development, Regulatory Affairs, and Medical Affairs to ensure scientific accuracy, compliance, and strategic alignment. Use artificial intelligence tools safely and effectively to maximize productivity and content quality, always respecting company standards.




Activities




Brand & Creative Direction

Design, execute, and propose strategic plans to position Saya's image on digital channels: look and feel, templates, recurring formats, and visual guidelines applied to posts and materials.




Content Strategy & Production

Design and publish content for social media (primarily LinkedIn) that communicates company milestones, product launches, and strategic alliances.




Digital Marketing & Distribution

Manage the editorial calendar: define objectives per piece/campaign, messages, formats, timing, owners, approval workflow, and publication.




PR & Media (Support)

Coordinate, along with the external PR agency, support for media opportunities when applicable: materials, message alignment, and internal validations.




Internal Coordination

Work closely with the Marketing Manager to align content with marketing strategy and launches.




Use of AI and Digital Tools

Leverage AI tools (Notion AI, internal agents, content generation tools) to accelerate drafting, trend analysis, and content optimization.




AI Red Lines: Do not use AI for medical/regulatory content without review; do not publish AI-generated content without human editing; do not share confidential information with external tools.




Monitoring and Analysis

Track mentions of Saya in media and social networks.

Identify trends and opportunities in the biopharmaceutical ecosystem in Mexico and Latin America.




Agency Management

Develop strategic briefs aligned with the launch roadmap and corporate priorities.




Education




Required:

University degree in Communication, Journalism, Public Relations, Marketing, or a related field.




Desired:

Demonstrable experience or interest in the healthcare, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology sector.

Familiarity with design tools (Canva, Figma, Adobe Suite). 




Experience

Minimum:

1-2 years of experience in digital content creation, social media management, or public relations.

Portfolio demonstrating the ability to create engaging and professional content.




Desired:

Previous experience in the healthcare, pharmaceutical, or B2B sectors.

Experience working with AI tools for content creation.

Experience in media, journalism, or press relations.




Professional Skills

Advanced English (reading and writing; many reference materials are in English)

Excellent Spanish writing skills (clarity, conciseness, and appropriate tone)

Proficiency in professional social media (especially LinkedIn)

Knowledge of basic design tools

Ability to translate technical concepts into accessible language

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

description:
About the job

About the Company







We're building the intelligence layer for the world's mobile carriers. Every phone call dropped, every support ticket opened, every subscriber lost to churn — these all trace back to one thing: carriers don't really see what's happening on their subscribers' devices. Octolytics changes that. We're a CXaaS (Customer Experience as a Service) platform trusted by mobile operators — MNOs and MVNOs — across Latin America and emerging markets. Our software runs inside the carrier apps of millions of subscribers, quietly turning raw device and network signals into the kind of intelligence that transforms how carriers operate, support, and grow.







About the Role







We're hiring an Android Engineer to help build the heart of the platform: the Octo Device Agent SDK. This SDK runs silently inside operator-branded Android apps, captures rich network and device telemetry, diagnoses connectivity issues in context, and executes remote remediations — all while respecting OS permissions and battery. You'll ship code that runs on real devices, in real networks, in production — not in a lab.







Responsibilities







Build and evolve our Android SDK: telephony APIs, connectivity diagnostics, IMS/VoLTE/VoWiFi state, APN configuration, signal and coverage telemetry.
Develop proof-of-concept Android apps that showcase the SDK to enterprise prospects and pilots.
Implement new measurement and remediation features alongside our backend team — defining contracts, log structures, and event schemas.
Investigate carrier- and device-specific edge cases (multi-SIM behavior, manufacturer quirks, OS-level restrictions) and design clean solutions.
Contribute to the upcoming UX redesign of the SDK companion experience.
Help us raise the bar on testing, release engineering, and operational maturity.







Qualifications







3+ years of professional Android development in Kotlin and/or Java.







Required Skills







Strong command of Android system APIs — telephony, connectivity, permissions, foreground/background services, lifecycle.
Experience designing, integrating, or shipping SDKs in production.
Comfort reading and writing technical documentation.
Working English (the team and our clients operate in English and Spanish).







Preferred Skills







Background in telecom, network telemetry, IoT, or mobile measurement products.
Experience with multi-SIM / dual-SIM behavior, carrier privileges, or operator-side configuration.
Familiarity with CI/CD for Android (signing, distribution, instrumented testing).

About the job

About The Role

Cybba is looking for a senior strategist to own media planning and strategy for the Brazil and Mexico markets and run it to US standards. This is a hands-on, end-to-end role: you take a client objective and carry it the full distance, from channel strategy and programmatic and social activation through attribution design, execution oversight, and the measured outcome.

You own the margin on what you build, you turn what works into repeatable managed offerings, and you keep a hard record of which proposals win and which lose so the next strategy is sharper than the last. You serve as the bridge between Cybba’s US capability and the LATAM market, fluent enough in both to present at a high level on either side.

Responsibilities

Media Strategy & Planning


Build end-to-end media plans across programmatic, paid social, and emerging channels for Brazil and Mexico, aligned to US planning standards. 
Translate client objectives into channel strategy, budget allocation, flighting, and measurement design. 
Own attribution planning, including foot traffic and closed-loop retail measurement where it applies (Gretel, Measurement Suite, Audience Intelligence). 
Stay current on each market’s media landscape, supply availability, and regulatory constraints (LGPD in Brazil, LFPDPPP in Mexico). 


Platform & Solution Depth


Plan and operate across DSPs: The Trade Desk, DV360, StackAdapt and MediaSmart 
Know the supply side: SSP landscape, inventory quality, and DOOH and CTV supply paths into each market. 
Run paid social strategy across Meta, TikTok, and the platforms that matter regionally. 
Use measurement and analytics platforms to set KPIs up front and prove outcomes at the end. 
Working knowledge of identity and audience solutions (LiveRamp and similar). 


Profitability & Productization


Own campaign and managed-service margin. Scope, price, and structure work to hit profitability targets, not just spend targets. 
Turn repeatable strategies into productized managed-service offerings the team can deliver efficiently and at scale. 
Document playbooks so delivery does not depend on a single person’s memory. 


Win/Loss Tracking & Feedback Loop


Track every proposal: won, lost, the reason, the competitor where known, and the economics. 
Run a structured feedback loop that pushes those outcomes back into the next round of strategy, pricing, and packaging. 
Identify the patterns behind wins and codify them. Discard what consistently loses. 


Client & Stakeholder Engagement


Present strategies, plans, and results to clients and internal leadership. The standard is senior, confident, and clear in all three languages. 
Partner closely with the US product, data engineering, and commercial teams so LATAM strategy and US capability stay in sync. 


Required Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field. 
6+ years in media planning and strategy with real programmatic depth. 
Hands-on DSP experience. You have built and optimized live programmatic campaigns, not just briefed them. 
Tri-lingual at professional working proficiency: English, Portuguese, and Spanish. All three are non-negotiable. 
Strong presentation and storytelling skills. You can hold a room and a screen share. 
Demonstrated ownership of strategy end to end, including the commercial outcome. 
Strong collaborator who works well across functions and time zones. 


Preferred Qualifications


Direct experience in the Brazil and Mexico media markets. 
Retail media and attribution background. 
Experience productizing managed services or solutions, not just running campaigns. 
Familiarity with agile or scrum delivery and the Atlassian stack (Jira, Confluence). 


Attributes & Professional Growth


Strong interest in operations best practices and bringing structure and rigor to planning, pricing, and delivery workflows. 
Strong appetite for continuous learning and platform certifications. Relevant credentials expected, or obtainable within the first 90 days: 
The Trade Desk Edge Academy 
Meta Blueprint 
Google (GA4 and Google Ads) 
DV360 or equivalent DSP certification 


6-Month Success Criteria


A documented, repeatable planning and pricing approach live for both markets. 
Managed-service margin at or above target on owned accounts. 
A live win/loss record with a feedback loop that has measurably improved win rate or proposal quality. 
At least one productized offering shipped and delivered at scale.

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Executive Social who will:

Advanced Excel skills.

We're channel-agnostic about how you do it: you might go deep and own a single channel, or stay broad and run across several. Paid ads, SEO, outbound, content, lifecycle, funnels — wherever your instincts pull you, we want people who can find what works and make it grow.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

About WPP Media

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com

Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. 
Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. 
Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. 


Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Executive Social who will:


Develop strong relationships with counterparts in WPP Media’s regional teams (Europe, United States and Asia). 
Support campaigns on Facebook Ads, Twitter Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Instagram Ads, etc., for clients, according to WPP Media guidelines. 
Ensure campaigns comply with WPP Media’s global policies and guidelines.

Generate daily campaign reports for reporting to regional teams.

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:


Bachelor’s degree. 
Advanced English level (B2–C2).

Advanced Excel skills.

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. Our benefits include access to internal learning platforms, certifications, and training sessions, life insurance, wellness programs, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, employee mental health awareness day, and more. 

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

You will help create and execute the growth strategy for McKinsey clients' digital sales.

About the job

Location: Remote

Type: Part-time / Contract / Pilot role

Languages: Russian, English required




About the project

We are building a product in the future of work space: a new professional profile for people who want to be better understood by recruiters, founders, hiring teams, and AI tools.

LinkedIn and resumes were built for human readers. But more professional discovery, hiring, and candidate evaluation is now supported by AI. We want to help people structure their experience, projects, achievements, proof points, and professional signals in a clearer way.




About the role

We are looking for a Middle Product Manager to help us test early product hypotheses, speak with users, improve onboarding, and turn feedback into product decisions.

This is an early-stage role. There will be fast tests, uncertainty, and a chance to influence the product from the beginning.




What you’ll do

Run user interviews and analyze feedback
Help define product hypotheses and test scenarios
Improve onboarding and first user experience
Work with professional profiles and understand what creates value
Write short product notes, specs, and conclusions from tests
Work closely with the founder, designer, and developer

2–5 years of experience in product management, product operations, startup operations, or similar roles
Strong Russian communication skills
Good English for working with international markets
Interest in AI, hiring, future of work, and professional identity
Ability to structure unclear problems
Experience using AI tools in daily work
Comfort with early-stage products and fast changes




Nice to have

Experience in HR tech, recruiting, career tech, professional networks, productivity, or AI products
Experience with international teams or remote work
Experience with MVPs, customer development, or early growth tests




Why this is interesting

AI is changing how people are found, evaluated, compared, and recommended. We believe professional identity will become one of the most important product areas of the next few years.

This is a chance to work on a product that can become useful not just for one company, but for every professional building a career in the AI-driven job market.

About the job

Who We Are

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.

We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

Who You Are

As a Customer Experience Specialist, you are a dedicated professional with extensive customer service and technical support experience. Your expertise is mostly in diagnosing issues, reporting bugs and incidents, providing practical solutions, and enhancing user satisfaction, including within international payroll, benefits, and EOR contexts. With a keen eye for detail and a commitment to excellence, you have a proven track record of successfully managing complex customer support cases, resolving critical moments, and developing innovative solutions that improve service delivery.

You have a unique ability to adapt your technical knowledge to assist our frontline support with a variety of situations, including navigating global customer scenarios, diagnosing their problems, and ensuring they receive timely and accurate solutions. You have the drive to continually identify and provide critical feedback to our internal teams to improve our product offerings and functions, including those supporting international expansion. You are excellent at communicating complex information about our product, processes, and international requirements in an understandable and patient way, which will be vital to building strong relationships with our internal customers and team members.

Your Success Profile

What You Will Work On


Serve as a primary point of contact for high-level customer support inquiries, including international payroll, benefits, and EOR-related cases, ensuring a positive resolution.
Own subject matter expertise across Justworks products, with a specialization in international offerings, and partner closely with Product teams.
Collaborate with Solutions, Incident Management, Technical, Product Development, and International teams to identify, analyze, and resolve complex domestic and global product issues.
Partner with International Consultants and cross-functional stakeholders to navigate compliance, HR, and regulatory nuances impacting global customers.
Develop and implement strategic solutions that improve customer experience, product performance, and scalability for international support.
Lead training sessions and workshops for internal teams on international workflows, new features, and best practices.
Enhance and build internal documentation, FAQs, and SOPs in CS Confluence/Help Center to support international customer scenarios and empower Customer Success teams.
Advocate for customer needs and insights, including international trends, in product development discussions to influence roadmap decisions.
Maintain biweekly and monthly syncs with stakeholders across Product, Operations, Legal, and International teams to stay aligned on updates and provide voice-of-customer feedback.
Identify opportunities for automation, AI integration, and workflow improvements to increase efficiency and accuracy in international support delivery.



How You Will Do Your Work

As a CX Specialist, how results are achieved directly impacts your success and ultimately our success as an organization. In this role, your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities, and personal attributes are anchored in the following competencies:

Consultative - takes an approach that focuses on building relationships with others, understanding their problems, and developing solutions to their challenges through open-ended questions and active listening.

Taking responsibility - being accountable, being committed, and accepting ownership for one's decisions, actions, and behavior.

Adaptability - the ability to adjust your approach or actions in response to changes in your external environment.

Solution-oriented - identifies the source of a question or challenge and provides the right or a better way of doing things.Curious - the innate desire to learn, grow, and understand.

In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:


Camaraderie - Day to day, you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.
Openness - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.
Grit - You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.
Integrity - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example. 
Simplicity - Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”



Qualifications


4+ years experience in a customer-facing role, ideally with experience in the EOR space.
Proven experience in a support role, ideally within a technical, advisory, or international/EOR support capacity.
Exceptional problem-solving skills with a proven track record of resolving complex technical issues.
Strong technical acumen, with the ability to quickly grasp new technologies, products, and software.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of conveying complex solutions in a clear and understandable manner.
Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across different teams and departments.
Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Together we are a powerful and highly complementary combination of market leading technologies.

We are the toolmakers for the world's most innovative companies, academic institutions, and government laboratories. We are their partners in discovery.

Malvern Panalytical instruments analyze the chemical, physical and structural nature of materials, from proteins to polymers and semiconductors to minerals. Our leading technologies measure particle size, shape, concentration and zeta potential, biomolecular interactions and stability, elemental concentrations and crystallographic structure.

Micromeritics manufactures systems for the characterization of particles, powders, and porous materials for a wide- range of end markets including catalysts, chemicals, building materials, clean-tech and battery. SciAps specializes in portable X-ray fluorescence (XRF), laser-based (LIBS) and near-infrared (NIR) analyzers to measure any element in any environment. SciAps is the Center of Excellence for our handheld instruments.

We have a global footprint with R&D and manufacturing sites in North America, Europe, and Asia.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills; must be fluent in English.

description:
About the job

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

Why this role is important to us

SimCorp leverages the most sophisticated risk analytics and portfolio-construction tools on the market, with a globally diverse client base that challenges us to continue innovating.

SimCorp is currently seeking a qualified professional to join our Customer Support team as a full-time employee. The position will be based in our Mexico City office. Candidates should have a minimum of a Master's in Finance, Quantitative Finance, Economics, or 1-2 years of relevant experience with a related degree. Beyond the opportunity to work directly with clients, team members will gain invaluable industry experience while working in a challenging, yet fun work environment.

What You Will Be Responsible For


Research and respond to pricing, risk analysis, attribution, and risk modeling questions from clients. 
Provide structured and custom training for new and existing clients. 
Assist clients in translating their risk analytics strategies into SimCorp products, while providing helpful insights into SimCorp’s innovative methods. 
Assist Sales Team members in creating proof-of-concept analysis via portfolio analysis and product demonstrations. 
Provide expert guidance during evaluations of SimCorp's software products including initial training, day-to-day usage questions, and by supporting the Sales and Product Specialists teams during client trials. 
Assist sales organization as necessary to facilitate strong client retention and new business development. 
Collaborate with senior Client Services staff and other SimCorp resources in responding to advanced client inquiries. 


What We Value


Strong written and oral English communication skills. 
Minimum of a Master's in Finance, Quantitative Finance, Economics, or 1-2 years relevant experience with a related degree. 
Knowledge with or experience with multi asset class securities (equity, fixed income, FX, and derivatives). 
Understanding of risk management concepts such as greeks, VaR, and stress testing. 
Strong educational foundation in math and statistics, familiar with linear and non-linear methods of interpretation in market theory and quantitative disciplines of risk analytics / portfolio construction. 
Strong computer skills and experience with coding languages (R / Python preferred, Java a plus). 
Strong ability to problem solve and quickly identify problem resolution for clients. 
Passion for assisting and teaching clients how to maximize the benefit of SimCorp products. 


Benefits

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid workplace model. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

NEXT STEPS 

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients, with SimCorp as the overarching company brand and Axioma as a key product brand.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

While seeking to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not optional. It is essential.

About the job

E-commerce Product & Search Relevancy Expert 




About the Role:




At TELUS Digital, we help the world’s biggest brands build smarter technology. As an E-commerce Product & Search Relevancy Expert , your mission is to help an AI learn how to suggest the perfect products to online shoppers. You will look at massive catalogs across various industries and decide which items belong together. You act as the "human logic" that ensures a customer sees a matching set or compatible accessories instead of a random, incorrect suggestion.




What You’ll Do:

description:
About the job

Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

The Account Executive (AE) for Small-to-Medium Business is a highly motivated self-starter who is responsible for developing and closing new business or expanding our footprint with current customers within the SMB business segment. A successful AE is eager to learn, determined to adapt quickly, and comfortable with some ambiguity. AEs are focused on acquiring new customers or selling additional use cases, products and services into existing accounts. This person is accountable for exceeding monthly and quarterly quotas, proactive deal management, forecast accuracy, and driving adoption and usage with customers and prospects in collaboration with internal teams and the broader Docusign partner ecosystem.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Sales Manager, SMB.

Responsibility


Drive success of the company's goals and objectives through achieving individual sales quotas
Build and manage a sales pipeline through prospecting efforts in the assigned territory within the SMB or Mid-Market segment
Develop and deliver customized sales presentations and products demonstrations, by phone and via online demo
Craft and negotiate enterprise level proposals and contracts
Forecast sales activity and revenue achievements accurately through proper use of sales tools
Collaborate effectively and engage various pre/post sales resources including Sales Development Representatives, Market Development Representatives, Solutions Engineers, Account Managers, Partner Account Managers, as well as Legal, Security, Professional Services and Customer Support
Travel as necessary, typically 10%


Job Designation

Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time.

Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

In Office: Employee works from the physical workspace 100% of the time.

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic


BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience


Preferred


Experience managing and closing software sales-cycles
Demonstrated ability to over-achieve quotas in past positions
Proficient computer application skills, including Salesforce.com, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel
IT industry and multinational environment background
English - intermediate level and above


Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

Accommodation

title: Account Manager - Creative Operations
skills: Own the account context for selected Creative Operations and Systems / Process Design clients: stakeholders, priorities, history, open questions, risks, decisions, and follow-ups.
Run the client operating rhythm so meetings, updates, actions, blockers, decisions, and handoffs do not drift or depend on memory.
Turn vague client requests into clear next steps, questions, owners, dependencies, and decision points.

Become highly capable with AI tools and workflows for account management: meeting preparation, account research, stakeholder mapping, summarisation, action tracking, client-ready drafting, QA, and reusable account memory.
Use AI to make your client work sharper, not just faster. The standard is better context, better questions, better follow-up, and fewer things slipping through gaps.
Make clients feel well looked after: clear communication, good energy, strong follow-up, useful questions, and the confidence that you are properly on top of their account.
Write clear client-ready summaries that make messy work understandable without overpromising or hiding uncertainty.
Maintain stakeholder maps, account notes, decision logs, follow-up trackers, and reusable context so Storm can manage the relationship professionally.
Work closely with Account Management, Creative Operations, AI Operations, and technical colleagues to keep client work moving.
Understand creative and operational workflows well enough to challenge weak assumptions, ask practical questions, and explain tradeoffs in plain English.
Spot when a client ask is really a workflow, visibility, approval, stakeholder, or operating-rhythm problem.
Help internal teams avoid overbuilding, underscoping, or saying yes before the client need is clear.
Improve the way account knowledge is captured, summarised, shared, and reused over time.
Demonstrable experience owning client relationships, stakeholder communication, account delivery, or complex operational conversations.
Strong written and spoken English. You can make a messy situation feel clear, calm, and practical.
High agency. You do not wait for every next step to be handed to you, but you know when to escalate early.
Structured thinking. You can break ambiguous work into users, inputs, outputs, owners, statuses, risks, decisions, and definitions of done.

A serious interest in becoming an expert at AI-enabled account management. You should already be using AI in real work and be hungry to get much better at it: tools, prompts, workflows, context packs, summaries, QA checks, and repeatable operating patterns.

Strong client presence. You are warm, confident, curious, responsive, and naturally good at making clients feel understood. People should like working with you, not just tolerate you because you are organised.
Comfortable working around workflow and collaboration tools such as Airtable, Monday.com, Notion, Asana, spreadsheets, Slack, Teams, or similar systems.
Enough systems/process literacy to understand what is being built, why it matters, where the risks are, and how to explain it to non-technical stakeholders.
Clients feel that Storm understands their priorities, stakeholders, open questions, and next steps.
Clients actively like working with you. They trust your judgement, enjoy your communication style, and feel calmer because you are involved.
You foster new opportunities and growth in existing agreements with clients.
Vague client asks become scoped decisions, useful follow-up questions, or clear internal action paths.
Account knowledge does not live in one person's head. It is captured, maintained, and easy for others to use.
Internal teams know what the client needs, what is blocked, who owns the next action, and what should not be promised yet.
Client meetings are better prepared because context, risks, decisions, and likely asks have been organised in advance.
AI becomes part of the account-management operating system: better prep, better memory, better summaries, better follow-up, and better visibility for internal teams and clients.
Storm can manage these client relationships with stronger continuity, less context loss, and less late-stage confusion.
You like being close to clients and close to how work actually gets done.
You enjoy turning messy client requests into clear, practical operating steps.
You are comfortable being judged on client clarity, follow-through, and operating outcomes, not just effort or friendliness.
You can combine warmth with structure.
You want to use AI as part of how you prepare, document, summarise, and improve account management.
You want to become expert at using AI to run account management better than a normal human memory-and-notes process can.
You want to be the person clients trust, enjoy speaking to, and ask for when something is messy or important.
You like roles where the answer is not already written down, but the next sensible step can be found.
You want to be a message-passer between the client and delivery team.
You prefer someone else to interpret ambiguity, own context, or decide what needs to happen next.
You are uncomfortable pushing back on weak scope or asking clients precise follow-up questions.
You want a pure delivery-management role with limited relationship responsibility.
You are not interested in becoming genuinely strong with AI tools and workflows, or you only see AI as a way to polish writing rather than improve how account management works.
You think client relationship management is mainly being polite, rather than becoming someone clients actively like, trust, and want in the room.
You need every workflow, owner, and decision path to be perfectly defined before you can move.
Remote-first team with international colleagues and globally recognised entertainment clients.
Modern hardware, collaboration tools, AI-enabled workflows, and room to improve how work happens.
Fast-moving culture where thoughtful ideas from people close to the work are valued.

🤝 Account-management role with real responsibility for client operating clarity, stakeholder context, and systems/process handoffs.
